description: This Java class implements a cache loader for asynchronously loading partial 'Thing' objects using a facade. It takes an entity-resource key, retrieves optional contextual information, and utilizes the facade to fetch partial data. It is part of a larger system managing signal enrichment in Eclipse Ditto.

classes.name: SignalEnrichmentCacheLoader
classes.description: A cache loader that asynchronously retrieves partial 'Thing' objects based on a key and context, delegating to a facade.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of SignalEnrichmentCacheLoader with the provided facade.

methods.name: asyncLoad
methods.description: Loads partial 'Thing' data asynchronously using the facade, considering optional context and selectors.
